source.collect_pg.py: Symbolia read-only PostgreSQL collector, RF-33 candidate: the RF-32 collector plus the objects and functions queries read again in each other database the databases query lists with datallowconn (catalog_snapshot.json#other_databases; the same login and read-only session with -d "dbname='<datname>'", a conninfo naming only the database, never retried); nothing else moved
source.QUERIES.json: the published query list of that revision with its other_databases section, regenerated by render_queries(); the collector writes its own copy into every output
source.SECRET-KEYWORDS.json: the published secret keyword list, unchanged
